requirement: Preserve system boundaries and typed relationships; mappings must not imply identity or erase differences.
acceptance_evidence: Boundary and mapping tests; documented exclusions

requirement: Declare initialization state, environment prerequisites, and readiness separately from authorization.
Persist records only under explicit durability, capacity, provenance, and retention contracts.
Enforce identity, purpose, scope, permission, provenance, and resource limits before retrieval or disclosure.
Preserve event, record, ingestion, and applicability time and governed correction/retraction history.
Declare measurement and inference assumptions; expose uncertainty and support abstention.
acceptance_evidence: Calibration, uncertainty, invalid-input and abstention tests

requirement: Expose missing, disputed, stale, invalidated, inaccessible, and incomplete information with full denominators.
Separate readiness, authorization, invariant compatibility, commit, failure, recovery, acceptance and release.
Preserve consent, privacy, refusal, withdrawal, non-coercion, and human accountability.
acceptance_evidence: Policy tests and approved human evaluation

requirement: Monitor capability sharing, resource use, performance and ongoing integrity without self-certification.
acceptance_evidence: Resource benchmarks, least-privilege and monitoring review

requirement: Separate event chronology, observation, coordinate description, inference and causal claims.
Do not use quantum or entropy terminology outside a declared model and valid domain.
Keep chemical/biological models within their evidenced domain; do not infer software life or consciousness from analogy.
Preserve failure evidence and versioned acceptance history; later regression or revocation changes current eligibility without erasing history.
acceptance_evidence: Incident, rollback, revocation and audit tests

requirement: Prevent coercive dependency and ensure capability sharing remains bounded, revocable, and overseen.
